name: S2.1 Pro
description: S2.1 Pro is Fish Audio's current state-of-the-art voice model — the best model we have, now available to every developer for free via API. It is a neural speech synthesis model designed for production-grade AI voice generation, with particular strengths in low-latency streaming, multilingual TTS, and voice cloning.
